title: Agents
description: The skills and the knowledge catalogue, and what their validators depend on. Neither child has a diagram of its own; see the open decision in Agents/.dev/decisions.json.

components.name: Agents
components.responsibility: Groups the skills and the knowledge catalogue an agent follows.

components.name: Skills
components.responsibility: The describe-* and populate-dev skills, the nine view schemas with fictional examples, the actor template, and validate_diagrams.py, which checks the schemas, their examples and every view and actor file in a repository.

components.name: Knowledge
components.responsibility: The catalogue of knowledge kinds: a schema per kind built on common.schema.json, a fictional example per kind, and validate_knowledge.py, which checks them and every knowledge file in a repository.

components.name: Documented repository
components.responsibility: The repository the validators are run on: its .dev/*.json files, its Markdown files and its Actors/ folder.

components.name: jsonschema package
components.responsibility: Draft 2020-12 schema validation, with the referencing package's registry for the knowledge schemas' references to common.schema.json.

relationships.description: validate_diagrams.py skips a .dev file whose kind has a schema in Knowledge/schemas, leaving it to validate_knowledge.py; describe-knowledge and populate-dev send the agent to Knowledge/README.md.
validate_diagrams.py walks the repository for .dev/*.json views and Markdown links to Actors/, and checks every path they cite exists.
validate_knowledge.py walks the repository for .dev/*.json knowledge files and checks every path they mention exists.
validate_diagrams.py validates schemas, examples and views with Draft202012Validator.
validate_knowledge.py validates with Draft202012Validator and resolves common.schema.json through a referencing Registry.
